claims.A8: Bathos run provenance is keyed by a project_slug column (144 runs under aminx) and the runs table has no separate project id column.

prereg.question: If the bathos project slug aminx were renamed, would existing run provenance be orphaned (i.e. is the slug the only project key on the runs table)?
prereg.expect_if_true: Rows show aminx with about 144 runs (>=100) and mpnn_ext with a few; the column query returns exactly one column, project_slug.
prereg.expect_if_false: The column query returns an additional project id column (provenance could survive a slug rename via the id), or aminx has far fewer runs than 100 (little provenance at stake).
